title: Shot fake
description: Ball up to the forehead, quick, knees bent, feet never leave the floor. Filmed from the shooting-hand side.
success: Great fake: quick, grounded and low. The defender is in the air.

feedback.fail: Sell it: bring the ball up to your forehead.
You left your feet. A fake only works if you stay grounded.

feedback.fail_high: Stay low on the fake so you can explode after.
feedback.fail_low: Don't sink so deep on the fake. Stay in your shooting stance, ready to go.

feedback.fail_high: Make it quicker: a long fake lets the defender recover.
feedback.fail_low: Hold it a split second longer so the defender bites.
